text:
[title] Speculative decoding
[body] A small draft model proposes gamma tokens
[body] The target model verifies them in one forward pass
[body] Rejection sampling keeps the output distribution exact

novice.takeaway: A method called speculative decoding uses a small model to guess tokens ahead of time, which a bigger model checks, to speed up AI responses without changing accuracy.
questions: How does rejection sampling ensure exactness?
Why is one forward pass faster than normal?
novice.inferred_claim: The presenter wants me to believe speculative decoding speeds up AI model responses while preserving accuracy.

peer.takeaway: A small draft model quickly proposes multiple tokens which the larger target model verifies in one pass, speeding decoding without changing output correctness.
questions: What determines the value of gamma?
How much overhead does verification add?
How does acceptance rate affect speedup?
peer.inferred_claim: Speculative decoding speeds up generation while preserving exact output quality.

expert.takeaway: The slide gives a standard summary of speculative decoding: draft model proposes tokens, target verifies in one pass, rejection sampling preserves exactness.
questions: What gamma value is used in their experiments?
How much latency reduction does this contribute vs PagedAttention alone?
expert.inferred_claim: Speculative decoding is a key, standard technique contributing to their 2.4x goodput improvement.
